content.short: Eigenpie is a specialized Liquid Restaking platform by Magpie, offering isolated LRT solutions for EigenLayer users.
content.description: Eigenpie is an innovative Liquid Restaking platform created by Magpie to provide specialized services within the EigenLayer ecosystem. It focuses on offering isolated Liquid Restaking Token (LRT) solutions, allowing users to restake assets without sacrificing liquidity or security. By supporting a wide array of Liquid Staking Tokens (LSTs), Eigenpie enables participants to earn rewards from both underlying staking and restaking, maintaining a flexible experience. The protocol maximizes capital efficiency and risk management through its isolated architecture, ensuring that risks associated with specific assets are contained within the vault.
content.meta: Discover Eigenpie, the liquid restaking platform by Magpie that optimizes EigenLayer yields with isolated LRT solutions on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
